what: PRB-1420, first part: every needs_review observation of occupation-full-publication-2026-10-27-v1 with kind religious_role or a label about prophets, seers, priests or Levites, decided by reading the verses. Admitted claims are in ../person-occupations.json; this file says why, and why not. Requests and the loader never read it.
rules: The noun or the verb of the office said of this person counts; a metaphor or a denial is noted.
A book prophet whom no text calls so gets Prophet with witness kind own-book (owner, 2026-11-01); one whom a text calls so gets the ordinary witness.
A list the text heads or closes with the office says it of each person named in it. A house name ("the children of X") or an ancestor does not hold it.
"X son of Y the priest": the title is the son's unless the Greek's case, BSB or another verse says otherwise.
Levite alone is standing, not occupation (TSK-1254, status_only); a stated service counts.
A plural group, or a quoted or hostile claim, is not an office without more. "Man of God" is an honorific (TSK-1251).
False prophet: the text's own verdict on someone who prophesied, as Ahab son of Kolaiah (owner, TSK-1254).
